name: TowerColocationTenancyManager
tagline: Tower loading, colocation applications and rent escalations in one Power Platform app
description: A complete tower-portfolio app for tower companies, operators and neutral hosts: structural loading per tower with an antenna elevation, a colocation application board with SLA and structural rules, fixed and CPI rent escalations with floor and cap, lease expiries and a tenancy register – for Canvas apps, Model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: 8 drill-down KPIs incl. tenancy ratio and rent roll
Structural loading meters with warning and pending applications
Antenna elevation by mount height and tenant
Application board with drag and drop, SLA countdown and approval rules
Pass with mods / capacity rule, MLA rule before installation
Fixed % and CPI escalations with floor and cap, apply all due with undo
Lease expiry and termination notice workflow
RF / height clash and projected loading warnings
Register with group, multi-select bulk actions and CSV export
